supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic HTTPS activity is consistently associated with the approved MediLedger updater domain, update.medledger.com, and the inventory-approved updater process medledgerupd.exe.

The updater connected through the explicit proxy to update.medledger.com at 13:37:04, 13:47:10, 13:51:53, 13:56:20, 14:02:07, and 14:06:22 UTC, broadly consistent with the inventory's approximately five-minute update-check cadence.
The same updater process made a request to update.medledger.com at 13:41:37 UTC, which the proxy denied; the records do not show that this denied attempt succeeded.

The host's recorded network events show connections to the proxy at 10.51.20.30:8080, with proxy CONNECT records naming the HTTPS destination; the records do not show a direct connection from the workstation to the destination service.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT destinations and tunnel byte counts, but do not expose the encrypted HTTPS content or establish what update data was exchanged (for example, T086-00168 and T086-00292).

The available records do not show a signature or hash verification result for medledgerupd.exe or the content received through its tunnels (process and connection records include T086-00164 and T086-00295).
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish the contents or authenticity of any update payload exchanged in the tunnels.
The evidence does not establish whether the updater's repeated checks resulted in an update being installed.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: tom.weber ran sqlcmd with a query selecting up to 100 rows from dbo.Users on DB-SRV-01; the available connection record to that host shows no completed TCP connection, so query success is not established (T086-00121, T086-00122, T086-00124, T086-00125).

Separate review: a logon for tom.weber on WS-TWEBER-01 was recorded from 10.51.10.24, an address also recorded as originating from WS-ESTONE-01; the evidence does not establish why this account was used from that workstation (T086-00062, T086-00064, T086-00328).
